scope: Preliminary inventory of source datasets named in T01–T06 DOCX files; generated projects, clipped grids, Suceava subsets and exported maps are not source datasets.
size_context: Owner-provided aggregate only: all vectors approximately 500 MB; two main rasters approximately 4 GB together (one approximately 1.5 GB and one approximately 2.5 GB). No size is assigned to any individual file.
distribution_note: Seturile GIS nu sunt incluse în repository. Sursele externe vor fi legate după verificare; fișierele de curs se obțin separat de la cadrul didactic.
